description: Static analysis for off-system token values: raw hex colors, non-scale border-radius px values, non-8pt spacing values, and magic z-index integers. Token scale source of truth: references/tokens.md. Accepts `code` string or `path`. Returns structured findings + summary.

code.description: Inline source code to lint (alternative to path)

path.description: File or directory path to lint (alternative to code)

name: tokens_lint
title: Tokens Lint
